_comment: Replica of coframe.com's homepage. 6th run against this site.
targetUrl uses the RESOLVED https://www. form: http://www.coframe.com 301s
to it, and capturing the pre-redirect URL would make every asset-map key
disagree with the host the browser actually requests from.
Site-specific knowledge lives ONLY in this file; scripts/** stay URL-agnostic.
_captureMode: coframe.com is Webflow == fully server-rendered, so the pristine pre-JS
response contains every structural node. Building from the RENDERED DOM
bakes in nodes the site's own JS created after load (cloneContent overlay
clones at z-index:9999, split per-letter hero spans, cursor clones); the
sanitizer strips runtime classes/styles but CANNOT remove nodes, so those
ship as permanently-visible duplicates. 'static' is verified correct for
this site; codegen prints the element-count ratio every run - re-check it.
_settleMs: Hero Rive chart + logo marquee need time to settle before capture.

_emptySelectors: Runtime clone HOSTS: shipped childless + inline style stripped.
.cursor-container is filled with .cursor bubble clones by the site's own
cursor engine at runtime. Kept as a defensive belt alongside captureMode.
_unwrapSelectors: Runtime WRAPPERS replaced by their own children, restoring pristine text
so the site's script can re-split it. .letter-effect spans are produced
by fadeInText() splitting the hero h1.

_viewports: Defaults are correct for this site (7 devices, 375-1920).
